title: dam config list answer
description: What dam config list prints on standard output with --json or --toon: where the two files are and every setting dam is using. A secret is never shown. A file that does not read gives the error document instead.

config.description: The path of config.lua, or null when there is none.

secrets.description: The path of secrets.lua, beside config.lua, or null when there is none.

setting.description: One setting, or a part holding settings by name, as dam config get prints it with --json. A leaf is the object whose default is a boolean, and a hidden credential is the object whose hidden is a boolean; any other object is a part, and a part may hold settings named value, default, hidden or function.

hidden.description: A credential, whose value is never shown. function is true for one dam calls when the remote is used, and false for one written as text.

value.description: The value. A token reads its grants in short, or disabled. It is null for a setting dam knows that the file leaves without a value and that has no default.

default.description: True when the file does not set it: dam then uses its own default, or nothing when value is null.
